summary: Take x a local unit at w whose residue generates (𝓞_E/w)^×, cyclic of order N − 1, and ν = x/x̄.

steps.claim: The residue field at w has N elements (split level), its unit group is cyclic of order N − 1; choose a local unit x at w whose residue has order N − 1 (units surject onto residue units).
steps.lean:
v (ν.1 w ^ i - 1) < 1 → D.N - 1 ∣ i := ((LocInt _).surjective_unitGroupToResidueFieldUnits
  |>.exists.1 (@IsCyclic.exists_ofOrder_eq_natCard (ResField w.1)ˣ _ _)).elim fun x h ↦

steps.claim: Take ν = x/x̄ (`divStar` of the local idele of x at w).
ν is integral of norm one and equals 1 at every place other than w and w̄ (w̄ ≠ w).
steps.lean:
simp +contextual [coe_divStar, ← map_inv, mem_Ô, ← card_ResField, mem_idelesUnitOff.1
    (locIdele_mem_idelesUnitOff (S := ∅) _), (v.mem_unitGroup_iff ..).1 x.2,
    ← D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.2 w, ← Nat.card_units,
    ← h, (ne_of_mem_of_not_mem _ (D.isSplitLevel_piPlaces.star_notMem _ w.2)).symm]

steps.claim: If ν_w^i ≡ 1 mod w then the residue of x^i is 1, so the order N − 1 divides i.
steps.lean: use fun i b ↦ orderOf_dvd_of_pow_eq_one (Units.ext (residue_eq_iff_valuation_sub_lt_one.2 b))⟩
